page_title: Jev Social — social research in your real browser

sources.entry: Jev Social - Local-first social research agent that uses Jev and socai to capture Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn evidence in Chrome. #opensource

summary.name: Jev Social
summary.one_liner: A local-first social research agent that takes a research goal, has the TypeSafe Jev model pick bounded socai CLI operations, and runs them in your real Chrome session to capture Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn evidence into source-linked cards and a Markdown report.
use_cases: research what people are posting about a topic on Instagram, TikTok, or LinkedIn
collect post links and evidence with a cited Markdown report
read comments on a specific social media post
download a selected TikTok video with its poster image
run social research without an API key by using your logged-in browser
summary.what_it_does: Jev Social takes a natural-language research goal for Instagram, TikTok, or LinkedIn. The TypeSafe Jev model chooses one bounded operation at a time (search, open a post or profile, read comments, download video, or finish) from the operations the installed socai CLI supports. The socai CLI executes each operation in the user's existing Chrome session and returns structured evidence. Captured results stream into cards while a final report is compiled with citations. The page's recorded examples show two searches and a post-detail read compiled into a Markdown report, with elapsed times and complete or partial status.
notable: Runs real CLI calls in the user's own Chrome session rather than mock data or a hosted scraper
Model cannot write shell commands or arbitrary selectors; it only picks from operations and targets observed in results
Can route decisions through OpenRouter Jev by default or a loopback Kev server without an OpenRouter key
MIT licensed and listed in the collective-ai-tools directory under Social Media
caveats: OpenAI Decisions API support is not yet wired; compatibility is not claimed until it can be tested end to end
On Linux the socai CLI must be installed from source first and placed on PATH or set via SOCAI_BIN
Login gates, step limits, and live-site behavior can yield partial results; comments were unavailable in one recorded run
Recorded timings are individual local observations, not a benchmark; no live benchmark results are published yet
